statement: A directory ingest MUST consider exactly those entries whose name ends in `.md` and does not begin with `.`.
note: Three of the five entries hold a syntactically perfect decision record and none of the three is a candidate: `Whyfile` is the reserved bare root name (REC-001), `notes.txt` does not end in `.md`, and the dotted file begins with `.`. An implementation that feeds every file to the parser produces 5 nodes where 2 are correct.
